verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform offers an API, but its documented scope is narrow: listing deployments, gathering findings and listing projects. The CLI covers scanning, SARIF export, autofix and rule testing, and an official MCP server is documented. Much of what the UI does has no documented API equivalent, including triage, ticketing and notifications, the rule editor, private rule publishing and Managed Scans onboarding, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of triage, rule management, and settings and onboarding; a published OpenAPI spec; any explicit UI/API parity statement; independent corroboration.
